blocks.text: 我们不应过于轻信，但应该更认真地对待实验室提出的那些看似“离谱”的AI网络安全想法。例如：Anthropic 曾因称 Mythos 级别的 AI 改变了网络安全而遭到嘲笑，@polynoamial 也曾因称模型会找到新颖的协调方式而遭到嘲笑。

blocks.text: Without being overly credulous, we should be taking seemingly “out there” ideas about AI cybersecurity from the Labs more seriously. Examples: Anthropic was mocked for saying Mythos-level AI changed cyber & @polynoamial for saying that models would find novel ways to coordinate.
